On July 9, 2026, the Company entered into a conversion agreement (the “Conversion Agreement”) with the holders (the “Holders”) of an aggregate of 15,507 shares of Series A Preferred Shares and Series B Convertible Preferred Stock (“Series B Preferred Shares” and together with the Series A Preferred Shares, the “Preferred Shares”), convertible into an aggregate of 35,648,276 shares of common stock at the reduced conversion price described below, pursuant to which the Holders agreed that upon the Conversion Closing (as defined in the Conversion Agreement), all of the outstanding Preferred Shares (the “Committed Preferred Shares”) shall be deemed to have been converted (the “Conversion”) into shares of common stock (or pre-funded warrants in lieu thereof).

On July 9, 2026, Cyabra entered into a conversion agreement (the “Conversion Agreement”) with the holders (the “Holders”) of an aggregate of 15,507 shares of Series A Preferred Shares and Series B Convertible Preferred Stock (“Series B Preferred Shares” and together with the Series A Preferred Shares, the “Preferred Shares”), convertible into an aggregate of 35,648,276 shares of common stock at the reduced conversion price described below, pursuant to which the Holders agreed that upon the Conversion Closing (as defined in the Conversion Agreement), all of the outstanding Preferred Shares (the “Committed Preferred Shares”) would be deemed to have been converted (the “Conversion”) into shares of Common Stock (or pre-funded warrants in lieu thereof).

The Conversion Closing and the Exchange Closing occurred on September 9, 2026, upon which all outstanding Series A Preferred Shares, Series B Preferred Shares and Series C Preferred Shares were converted into, or exchanged for, shares of Common Stock, Pre-Funded Warrants, Series A Common Warrants and Series B Common Warrants.
